ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio skewed toward low-intensity pixels; approximately 85% low-intensity (black/dark grey) vs 15% high-intensity (white/tan) concentrated in edge clusters and central mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white/grey mottling concentrated in the upper-mid section of the left lobe; dense, contiguous high-intensity circular clusters (barnacles) localized along the distal tips and trailing edges of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 15% of the total fluke vertical bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely irregular topography; left lobe shows high-frequency, high-amplitude protrusions (3-8mm pixel scale) caused by external attachments; right lobe exhibits smoother topography with a major serrated cluster at the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical sweep; left lobe trailing edge exhibits a concave curve with a sharp vertical lift at the tip; right lobe shows a straighter, linear trajectory toward the distal point.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast circular clusters along the entire trailing edge of the left lobe and the tip of the right lobe, appearing as white-tan raised pixel groups on dark backgrounds.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions visible in the central region of the left lobe lobe, appearing as thin, vertical and diagonal 'rake' patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral colonization of macro-parasitic structures along the entire trailing boundary of the left lobe, significantly altering the natural geometric silhouette of the fluke.
